newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Nafta to buy Isramco shares.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Nafta to buy Isramco shares.

text.p: Nafta Israel Petroleum Corp's board of directors approved the purchase of 36.5 percent of Isramco for 32.39 million shekels, Nafta said in a statement to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange on Thursday.
The shares and a further 2.5 million options of A and B series will be purchased from JOEL Jerusalem Oil Exploration Ltd.
The deal has yet to be approved by JOEL's board of directors, the statement said. The decision also has to be approved by Nafta's general assembly.
Nafta, Isramco and JOEL are all oil exploration companies.
